HomePage.title: Focus on <execution>execution.</execution>
HomePage.description:
The smart task partner for professionals.

Eliminate the gap between planning and execution to maximize your performance.

A new task management tool that visualizes the flow of time.

visualized.title: Visualized Timeline
visualized.description:
Capture time "visually".

Real-time visualization of the remaining time of the day and total task volume. Eliminate vague anxiety and provide clear visibility.

execution.title: Seamless Execution
execution.description:
Uninterrupted thinking, smooth execution.

Start and end tasks with just one action: the play button. Eliminating complex operations to not hinder your immersion into the flow state.

logging.title: Reliable Logging
logging.description:
Results refine the next plan.

Automatically log planned vs. actual management. A feedback loop based on data, not intuition, sharpens your sense of time.

section_planning.title: Section Planning
section_planning.description: Divide and manage your day by time zones (sections). Plan reasonably according to the context.

one_click_timer.title: One-Click Timer
one_click_timer.description: Intuitive stopwatch function. Clarify the task currently being executed.

hierarchical_planning.title: Hierarchical Planning
hierarchical_planning.description: Set goals for yearly, monthly, and weekly periods. Realize unhesitating execution with task design based on higher-level goals.

Search.title: Search tasks
Search.hint_body: Search task titles and memos with keywords (multi-word AND) and optional date ranges.

Finance.settingsDescription: Optionally record yen expenses and income on dated tasks. This setting is off by default.
Finance.settingsToggleHintOn: Money fields appear on dated tasks, and totals appear in daily and planning headers.
Finance.settingsToggleHintOff: Money fields and totals are hidden. Existing records are kept and are not deleted.
Finance.settingsEntitlementNote: This is a personal feature preference, not a paid-plan setting.
Finance.settingsSaveError: Could not save the money tracking setting. Check your connection and try again.
Finance.sectionDescription: These records are private to you, even on a shared project task.
Finance.summaryAria: Money summary: expense {expense}, income {income}. Open breakdown.
Finance.summaryRetryAria: Could not load the money summary. Retry and open the breakdown.
Finance.breakdownEmpty: No money records in this period.
Finance.saveTaskFailed: Could not save the task. Check your connection and try again.
Finance.saveFinanceFailed: The task was saved, but money records could not be saved. Your entries are still here — try saving again.
Finance.loadFinanceFailed: Could not load existing money records. Saving is blocked so those records are not overwritten.
Finance.saveBlockedFinanceLoading: Money records are still loading. Wait until they appear, then save.
Finance.saveBlockedFinanceError: Existing money records could not be loaded. Retry the load before saving.
Finance.validationAmount: Amount must be a positive whole number in yen (no decimals, zero, or exponents).
Finance.validationRows: Fix the money records before saving.
Finance.validationTooMany: You can add at most {max} money records per task.
Finance.needDate: Set a date to record money on this task.
Finance.datedTypeRequired: Items with money records must remain a dated task or daily goal. Save after removing the records before changing the item type.
